correctness.rationale: Exact terminal-child appointment probability 1/(n-1)_r leads to correct one-/two-vertex inclusion–exclusion excluding a younger counted parent. The uniform factorial-series covariance kernel c(a,b)=e^-a[(1+(a-1)b)e^-b-1] was checked algebraically, including r=1 boundary factors; its integral over 0<b<a<1 is (5-e^2)/(4e^2), diagonal 1/2-e^-1+e^-2/2, total (3-e)/e^2 independently integrated by SymPy. The undirected-root correction has probability 1/(n-1) and changes variance only O(1). Exhaustively enumerated all parent arrays n=3..8 directly for undirected M0, and checked source pair formulas against its verifier source. Existing Holmgren–Janson protected-count CLT supplies normality. Finite checks do not prove uniform o(n^-1) asymptotics.
